name: obsidian-vault-manager
description: Obsidian vault knowledge management plugin: agents and skills for note creation, MOC management, project tracking, inbox review (4-phase pipeline with ≥3x token reduction), project archiving, note↔project bidirectional binding, Obsidian-native formatting guidance, optional Defuddle URL extraction for captures, optional Obsidian CLI acceleration, and vault-audit (9-error-type structural integrity scan with ≥93% detection / <10% FP against fixture), plus reusable shell primitives (ovm-primitives.sh) for frontmatter scanning, wikilink extraction, and audit-state tracking.
